column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 / Prica seasonal event

column2: Heehee... you caught me!
Heh heh heh...
Um, you see...
This is my homemade chocolate! It's got $$ブルーベリー$$ and corn in it, but...
$$おにいちゃん$$, you'll eat it for me, right!?
Whaaa...
B-$$おにいちゃん$$... but don't you ever again...
go out to get $$薬$$ or anything...
Okay...?
Ugh... the taste and all that...
But, but, but... I don't want you going out all on your own...
Huff... huff... B-$$おにいちゃん$$...
My tummy's kind of...
It feels like pipipiro-goro-kaboom, or something...
Huff... huff... U-ugh... I feel sick...
Spring's the season for fresh cabbage!
Pile lots of different herbs on top of cabbage, and then cheese...
And tomato sauce...
And strawberry jam to finish it off...!
Sounds really yummy, doesn't it... $$おにいちゃん$$!
What a nice morning. Maybe a light fruit salad for breakfast!?
$$プリン$$ would be nice too, $$おにいちゃん$$...!
Hey, $$おにいちゃん$$. What's in season now—huh!? Tomatoes and cucumbers!?
Maybe we should just crunch crunch crunch on them with salt... okay?
It's been nothing but $$野菜$$ lately...
Maybe we should sometimes eat something that gives us stamina too, $$おにいちゃん$$.
Morning... Huh!? What's this here...?
Could it be matsutake!?
Oh, I thought it was, but it's shiitake—the mushrooms I haaate!!
When autumn comes... huh!?
“When it becomes autumn”!?” Heeheehee... that's funny. Right, $$おにいちゃん$$?
Winter means daikon is delicious—
so it's got to be simmered daikon!
A little splash of soy sauce, and let's eat, $$おにいちゃん$$...!
Morning. *slurp*... When it's this cold, don't you feel like hot pot, $$おにいちゃん$$?
Spring means the fields are full of $$野菜$$,
and that makes me so happy! $$おにいちゃん$$...!
I went to the field yesterday, and tomatoes and cucumbers were growing so nicely!
All riiight! I'm gonna eat lots!
Ah! O...
Sweet potatoes!! This has got to be roasted sweet potato!
Roasted sweet potato, right, $$おにいちゃん$$!!
Leeks, daikon, and turnips are in season right now, huh!?
Whoa, $$おにいちゃん$$! You really know everything!!
What's wrong, $$おにいちゃん$$...
Could it be... that you're not feeling well?
Okay, okay! $$おにいちゃん$$, do you want to be spoiled by meee?
But keep working hard at your $$リハビリ$$ too!!
Come on... let's sleep together... I'm tired too...
Hey, $$おにいちゃん$$, are you okay? Don't push yourself, pleeease!?
If you hurt yourself, then nothing good comes of it!!
My wish is... just don't overdo it!
Okay, $$おにいちゃん$$...?
$$おにいちゃん$$, good job today!
I heated up the bath... Let's make it all bubbly and play together!?
Waaah, you worked so hard today!!
I'll work hard too, so I don't lose to $$おにいちゃん$$!!
